properties.notes: Under construction but historically stalled site. An application was approved in 2017 (ref: P/2017/0598/73) for the variation of house types to change the 2 bedroom dwellings to 3 bedroom, which meant the initial layout has also been amended.. Partial demolition and refurbishment of existing bowling club including the creation of a new car park to serve the bowling club. Reduction in size of the bowling green and the erection of 1no. detached house and 16no. semi-detached houses with associated parking and landscaping.
